cards.title: Discard a draft entry
cards.description: A draft entry you do not want no longer lingers in your books. Ask Maipa to discard it, or Maipa will ask when you decline one. After you approve, the draft is set aside, nothing is posted, and the statement line it came from is free for the corrected entry.

cards.title: Why cash and profit differ
cards.description: The cash flow now explains the gap between your profit and the change in your bank balance: what you have earned or owe but not yet received or paid, and cash moved by things like equipment, loans and owner money. Comparing two periods also shows the difference in cash.

cards.title: See where your cash went
cards.description: Your financial statements now include a cash flow: what your bank and cash accounts held at the start and end of the dates you choose, and what was received and paid in between, by account. Ask Maipa where the money went.

cards.title: Maipa’s building blocks are up to date
cards.description: The published components Maipa is built from, including the one that connects your Claude or Codex account, were updated to their latest releases. Nothing changes in how you work.

cards.title: See your income statement and balance sheet beside the chat
cards.description: Ask Maipa to show your results for any dates. The income statement and balance sheet open beside the conversation and always read the current posted figures from your books.

cards.title: Keep a report as a pinned view
cards.description: Ask Maipa to keep a report, such as this year’s results, and it is pinned for you. A pinned view remembers only the books and the dates, so it shows current figures each time you open it.

cards.title: Update cards are a slim banner
cards.description: The update card is now a wide, short banner in line with the conversation, so it takes much less room until you dismiss it.

cards.title: What's new no longer covers the chat
cards.description: These update cards now sit in their own strip under the header instead of floating over the page, so they no longer hide the Connect button, the message box or the Account menu. Dismiss them and the strip disappears.

cards.title: See your statements and reconciliation beside the chat
cards.description: Ask Maipa to show your bank statements or a reconciliation. The list says what each statement still needs before it can be reconciled, and the reconciliation shows bank against books, the open items and the exact difference, read live from your books.

cards.title: Record a bank reconciliation
cards.description: When a statement agrees with your books, you can approve recording that you reviewed it. Maipa keeps the figures as they stood and tells you if later changes alter them. A statement with any difference cannot be recorded.

cards.title: Add balances to an earlier statement
cards.description: A statement imported without its opening and closing balance can have them added, so it can be reconciled. They are accepted only if the statement's lines add up from one to the other.

cards.title: Maipa can reconcile a bank statement
cards.description: Ask Maipa whether your books agree with a bank statement. It compares the statement's closing balance with your books, lists the statement lines not yet posted and the entries the bank has not shown, and tells you the exact difference if any remains. It only reports; it changes nothing.

cards.title: Tie an earlier statement to its bank account
cards.description: A statement imported before Maipa recorded bank accounts can now be tied to its account afterwards, with your approval. Its lines can then be matched, marked as repeats and reconciled like any other. No entries or amounts change.

cards.title: Processor payouts in one entry
cards.description: A payout from a payment processor can now be recorded as one entry: the net amount into your bank, the fees as an expense, and the full sale as income. Before, an entry had to total exactly the bank line.

cards.title: Reversed entries free their statement line
cards.description: If an entry made from a statement line is reversed, the line now shows as needing an entry again, and Maipa can match it to the corrected entry. Before, it stayed marked as posted.

cards.title: Overlapping statements are not booked twice
cards.description: If two statements of the same account overlap, the repeated lines are no longer booked a second time. Maipa asks you to approve marking each repeat, showing both lines side by side. Two identical lines on one statement stay two transactions.

cards.title: Transfers between your accounts are booked once
cards.description: When you move money between two of your bank accounts, it appears on both statements. Maipa now books it as one entry and matches the second statement line to it, so a transfer is never counted twice or mistaken for income.

cards.title: Attach a PDF statement
cards.description: You can attach a bank statement as a PDF. Maipa reads its text and works out the transactions, then asks you to approve them. The card shows every row and the statement's opening and closing balance.

cards.title: PDF rows must add up
cards.description: A PDF import is refused unless the rows add up exactly from the opening balance to the closing balance, and every amount actually appears in the document. A scanned PDF without text cannot be read.

cards.title: Larger statement files are accepted
cards.description: Statement files larger than about 64 KB were being refused, although the limit shown is 512 KB. CSV and Excel statements up to the full 512 KB now upload, both in the chat and in Bookkeeping.

cards.title: Approval cards show the whole request
cards.description: A long description on an approval card is no longer cut off part-way, so you can read everything Maipa is asking you to approve. Maipa is also told to keep its own working notes out of its replies.

cards.title: Attach an Excel statement
cards.description: You can now attach a bank statement saved as an Excel file (.xlsx) in the chat, not only a CSV. It needs one sheet with the headings date, description and amount. Maipa keeps your original file and tells you exactly which row to fix if something is wrong.

cards.title: Statements belong to a bank account
cards.description: When you import a bank statement, Maipa now records which bank account it is from. Entries made from its rows must move that account by the exact amount, in the right direction, so money in can never be booked as money out.

cards.title: Mark your bank and cash accounts
cards.description: Your books now know which accounts are bank accounts or cash on hand. Checking is marked for you; ask Maipa to mark a savings or cash account and approve it in one click. No amounts change.

cards.title: Maipa can show your accounts and entries
cards.description: Ask Maipa to show your chart of accounts, your journal entries or the history of one account. It opens them beside the chat, read straight from your books, so the figures are always the real ones.

cards.title: Start your books with opening balances
cards.description: Tell Maipa what you already had on the first day of your books, such as your bank balance, equipment and amounts owed. It prepares one opening entry for you to approve, checks your figures against the totals from your records, and shows exactly what goes to opening balance equity.

cards.title: Maipa can check your books are sound
cards.description: Ask Maipa whether your books are sound. It rechecks every entry: each one balances, nothing was altered after it was saved, posted entries have their posting record and reversals match their original. It reports anything it finds and changes nothing.

cards.title: Compare two periods
cards.description: Ask Maipa how one period compares with another, for example March against February. It reads both periods from your posted entries and reports the exact change in income, expenses, profit and balances.

cards.title: Income statement and balance sheet
cards.description: Bookkeeping now shows an income statement and a balance sheet built from your posted entries. Ask Maipa for any date range, for example your profit in March; it reads exact figures from your books instead of estimating them.

cards.title: Close a finished month
cards.description: Ask Maipa to close your books through a date. After you approve, nothing can be added, posted or reversed on or before that date, so finished months stay as they are. Maipa can ask to reopen them if you need to, again with your approval. Bookkeeping shows the current close date.

cards.title: Clearer setup and replies
cards.description: A finished account setup now says it is saved, the reporting basis reads as Cash or Accrual, and Maipa's replies start a new paragraph after it uses a tool instead of running sentences together.

cards.title: Maipa can undo a posted entry
cards.description: Ask Maipa to reverse an entry that was posted by mistake. It requests a reversal for your approval; approving posts the exact opposite entry, linked to the original, so your balances are corrected and the history stays intact. An entry can be reversed once.

cards.title: Attach your bank statement in the chat
cards.description: Attach a CSV file (up to 512 KB) to a message and Maipa receives it. Ask it to import the statement and it requests an import of that exact file for your one-click approval. Other file types are not delivered yet and are refused before sending.

cards.title: Maipa carries on after you approve
cards.description: When you approve or reject a change, Maipa is told the exact outcome and continues with what is left. You no longer need to say that you approved. If Maipa is still replying, it continues as soon as that reply finishes.

cards.title: Maipa does the bookkeeping
cards.description: Ask Maipa to create books, add accounts, import a statement you paste, or post the entries it prepared. It now does the work itself instead of sending you to a form.

cards.title: You approve every change in one click
cards.description: Each change Maipa wants to make appears in the conversation as an approval card showing exactly what will change, including the entry lines. Approve or reject one card, or approve a related batch together. Nothing changes until you approve, and Maipa cannot approve for you.

cards.title: Maipa guides your account setup
cards.description: Once an agent provider is connected, Maipa — your real AI agent — walks you through account setup in the conversation. It explains each step, understands ordinary replies such as a greeting, and records only the answers you actually give.

cards.title: Every setup step explains itself
cards.description: The Account setup panel lists each step with what it is for, shows the answers recorded so far, and lets you answer any step yourself. Nothing reaches client records until you press Confirm and save setup; Maipa cannot confirm it for you.

cards.title: Start keeping your books
cards.description: Open Bookkeeping in the header to create business books, use the account chart and prepare source-linked journal entries. Split an entry across accounts and review its exact amounts.

cards.title: Import a bank statement
cards.description: Upload a CSV statement in Bookkeeping. Each row is saved exactly as a pending transaction linked to its file; a bad row stops the whole import, and importing the same file again changes nothing. Ask Maipa to categorize the rows, then review and post each entry yourself.

cards.title: Let Maipa prepare entries
cards.description: Your connected agent can read your own books and prepare balanced entries in the shared Bookkeeping component. Prepared entries stay pending until you review and post them.

cards.title: See your posted trial balance
cards.description: Post the exact reviewed entry with your own account. Reopen the saved journal and see its actual debit and credit balances; pending entries stay separate.

cards.title: Follow one account
cards.description: In the trial balance, choose View activity to see an account’s posted entries in date order with a running balance and source reference. Entries awaiting your review are listed separately and are not counted.

cards.title: Account menu closes when you click away
cards.description: The Account menu now closes when you click elsewhere or press Escape, so it no longer covers the controls in your work panel.

cards.title: Remember a model for future connections
cards.description: In Agent settings, remember the model your connected provider has confirmed. Your current conversation and unsent message stay in place. The saved choice applies the next time you connect.

cards.title: Choose the provider default again
cards.description: Clear a saved model without changing your active connection. If a provider cannot confirm your saved choice, it is kept so you can review it or choose the default before reconnecting.

cards.title: Name your agent accounts
cards.description: Choose a clear name for your selected account in Agent settings. Keep your existing sign-in, conversation and unsent chat message.

cards.title: Review conflicting account names
cards.description: If another window changes the name, review the saved value while keeping your text. Choose which name to use before saving again.

cards.title: Keep the latest reply in view
cards.description: Chat now includes the spacing between messages when measuring its scroll position. Back to latest reaches the newest reply, including when the contextual panel changes size.

cards.title: Keep following while resizing
cards.description: Resizing the window keeps the latest reply visible. Scrolling up still pauses following so you can read earlier messages.

cards.title: Open common views from the header
cards.description: Use the header icons for Agent settings, Clients and, for administrators, User management. They open the existing components directly, even before connecting your agent.

cards.title: Keep your place in the conversation
cards.description: Open and close a common view while keeping your unsent message. When connected, the shortcut opens the same contextual panel shared with Maipa.

cards.title: Open your agent settings
cards.description: Ask Maipa to show settings for your supported provider and owned accounts. Private app profile assignment is shown separately from actual connection status.

cards.title: Choose an acknowledged model
cards.description: Use the providerâ€™s available models for the current live connection. Settings and chat show the same confirmed choice without replacing your conversation or unsent draft.

cards.title: Keep your unsent message
cards.description: Your saved draft now returns after reload for the same account, including pasted text and file names. Saving a draft never sends it.

cards.title: Retry without another copy
cards.description: A prepared send keeps its original retry identity across reload. Confirmed sends clear only their matching draft; newer typing is kept. File contents still need supported delivery.

cards.title: Inspect the same saved run
cards.description: Maipa can select a saved run and open its details in your workflow component. Your own run choice and detail visibility are saved and restored on reload.

cards.title: Keep failures separate from repairs
cards.description: Run history keeps the failed version and its actual result. A repaired publication runs as a new immutable version; selecting history clearly identifies an older run.

cards.title: Authorize your agent in the app
cards.description: Open Agent permissions in a client workflow. An administrator can allow their current connection to run, inspect, resume and cancel workflows for that client for up to an hour.

cards.title: Revoke execution when needed
cards.description: Revoke the connection permission from the same component. Subsequent agent actions and worker nodes check current access; reauthorizing cannot revive a run whose original grant was revoked.

cards.title: Choose a client by name
cards.description: Maipa can discover your available client entities when creating a workflow. Human approvals and answers continue to require you.

cards.title: Run your shared workflow
cards.description: Publish the saved graph, provide run input, and start it with the local workflow worker. Saved runs show their actual status, node results and outputs.

cards.title: Answer a workflow question
cards.description: Approval and input requests appear beside the graph. Your recorded answer resumes the same run; you can cancel a waiting run.

cards.title: Keep execution tied to access
cards.description: Maipa can request and inspect runs when its current connection already has the required workflow authority. Unavailable workers, stale graphs and revoked access refuse the operation.

cards.title: Build a workflow together
cards.description: Ask Maipa to create a workflow draft. The shared Fancy editor shows its nodes and connections, and you can move nodes or edit their settings.

cards.title: Keep shared changes saved
cards.description: Your edits and Maipa edits use the same saved draft. Conflicts keep your unsaved graph for review, and reloading restores saved work.

cards.title: Save a workflow version
cards.description: Ask Maipa to publish the current draft as a saved version. Publishing saves the definition without starting a run.

cards.title: Fill a client form together
cards.description: Ask Maipa to open Client setup and fill its pending names. You can edit the same saved input. Creating a client still requires your Create client action.

cards.title: Keep control of shared edits
cards.description: Conflicting edits keep your unsent input for review. A brief notice marks confirmed Maipa edits, and reloading restores saved input without replaying that notice.

cards.title: Understand a failed reply
cards.description: Chat can show the provider-reported failure category and reset time in Connection details. Unconfirmed causes stay unconfirmed, and raw provider error text stays private.

cards.title: Keep your draft during a usage limit
cards.description: A reported future reset pauses new sends for that account. Your draft remains editable, status survives login, and no reply is retried automatically.

cards.title: Compose smaller, useful pieces
cards.description: Maipa can compose compact headings, commentary callouts and a read-only client table in the shared panel using Fancy components.

cards.title: Reopen current client records
cards.description: A saved client table keeps your column choice and loads current authorized records when reopened. Failed reloads clear old rows and offer a retry.

cards.title: Keep useful views close
cards.description: Save a composed panel as your personal pin. Reopen it without losing your conversation or draft, rename or reorder it, and unpin it while keeping its definition history.

cards.title: Shared, confirmed view changes
cards.description: Saved-view changes use current ownership, role and revision checks. Maipa waits for confirmed saves, and conflicts offer a reload instead of overwriting another edit.

cards.title: Keep chat controls in view
cards.description: The message composer stays in view as the window gets shorter. Conversation history scrolls in the space above it, and long drafts use a smaller editor in short windows.

cards.title: Keep drafts edited during a send
cards.description: An edited draft stays yours while a message is sending, even when you change it back to the original words. Maipa uses Fancyâ€™s published draft-revision fix.

cards.title: A complete Fancy chat composer
cards.description: Chat now uses Fancy PromptInput and its contextual request drawer. Drafts stay editable during sends and survive failed confirmations and provider changes.

cards.title: Read conversations at your pace
cards.description: Fancyâ€™s measured message list keeps long conversations responsive. Scrolling up pauses following; Back to latest resumes it.

cards.title: Fancy content and composer controls
cards.description: Agent replies, setup guidance and shared notes use Fancyâ€™s content renderer. The message input uses Fancyâ€™s multiline component while keeping drafts and confirmed sends.

cards.title: Consistent connection controls
cards.description: When a connection changes, model choices and sign-in controls stay with the current conversation.

cards.title: Choose your agent model
cards.description: Choose from models offered by your connected provider. A confirmed change keeps your conversation, draft and shared panel in place.

cards.title: Recover connections after a restart
cards.description: A server restart now clears stale connection controls while keeping your accounts, saved chat and unfinished requests.

cards.title: Use your existing Claude sign-in
cards.description: Claude checks the account already signed in on this machine. Maipa offers sign-in only when it is needed.

cards.title: Claude sign-in link restored
cards.description: Maipa now recognizes Claudeâ€™s current sign-in address and shows its private account connection controls. Live model verification is still in progress.

cards.title: Connect your Claude account
cards.description: Claude now has its own connection and private sign-in controls. Your selected provider, saved chat and unsent drafts stay separate from other accounts.

cards.title: Shared agent tools
cards.description: Claude uses the same authorized contextual UI components in chat. Live model verification and additional ACP connections are still in progress.

cards.title: Ready after agent startup
cards.description: The connection stays in Connecting until the agent finishes startup. A startup failure keeps the connection unavailable, and you can stop while it connects.

cards.title: Live agent work continues
cards.description: Your saved account and chats stay in place. Actual model-driven UI verification and additional ACP connections remain in progress.

cards.title: Clearer connection status
cards.description: The Codex connection now asks you to sign in only when the provider confirms you are signed out. A failed status check shows that the connection needs attention.

cards.title: Live agent work continues
cards.description: Your saved provider choice, account and chats stay in place. Actual model-driven UI verification and additional ACP connections remain in progress.

cards.title: Agent startup correction installed
cards.description: The Codex connection now uses the supported startup correction. Fresh sessions stay within the existing private-profile limits.

cards.title: Live agent verification continues
cards.description: Your provider choice and saved chats are retained. Actual model-driven UI verification and additional ACP connections are still in progress.

cards.title: Choose your agent provider
cards.description: The chat now saves your provider choice and keeps each accountâ€™s conversation separate. Unsent drafts return when switching between providers in the open app.

cards.title: Connection support stays explicit
cards.description: Providers without a supported connection remain unavailable instead of falling back to Codex. Additional ACP connections and the Codex startup correction are still in progress.

cards.title: Reconnect a stopped conversation
cards.description: Reconnect now checks your saved conversation and restarts a stopped connection, keeping the transcript and your unsent draft.

cards.title: Provider startup correction in progress
cards.description: The connection can still stop shortly after subscription sign-in. The provider startup correction and real agent verification are still in progress.

cards.title: A conversation, with room to work
cards.description: The new shell gives chat the workspace and supports contextual components alongside it. Closing a panel returns that space to chat. The live agent integration is still being verified.

cards.title: Connect your ChatGPT subscription
cards.description: Start sign-in from the conversation using your own ChatGPT subscription. The connection and saved chat belong to your Maipa account. The live agent workflow is awaiting its final sign-in and model verification.

cards.title: Private agent UI tools
cards.description: Agent UI requests now keep your account and access boundaries. Provider sign-in and live chat are still in progress.

cards.title: Manage your clients and entities
cards.description: Administrators and preparers can create their own client records, add entities and change display names in Client setup beside the conversation. Changes keep a history, and conflicting edits require a reload before another save.

cards.title: Agent connection is still being built
cards.description: Private agent profile storage now has account ownership and isolated-worker checks. Provider sign-in and live conversations remain in progress.

cards.title: Manage local users and roles
cards.description: Administrators can add local users and update workspace roles and access in Users and access beside the conversation. Changes keep a revision history, conflicting edits require a reload, and the last active administrator stays protected.

cards.title: Agent setup is still in progress
cards.description: Private agent accounts keep their own scope. Provider connection and live conversations are still being built.
